skyeGreeting: G'day, I'm the Coastline Carpentry & Handyman assistant. Got a deck, some carpentry or a list of jobs around the house? Tell me what needs doing and I'll help you get a quote or book a time.

about.headline: One reliable tradie for the whole job list.
about.body: Most people call with a list: a sticking door, a wobbly deck board, something in the bathroom, and a carpentry job they've been putting off. Brandon works through it in one visit, turns up when he says, and tells you straight how long it'll take.

realReviews.author: Louise K
realReviews.text: I highly recommend Brandon and his services. He delivers high quality and precise craftsmanship. He was able to execute exactly what I envisioned and also gave his professional advice to make it even more aesthetically appealing. Brandon is easy to communicate with, punctual and reliable. I know exactly who I will be calling when I next need a carpenter/ handyman!

realReviews.author: Candice Girdham
realReviews.text: Brandon is our family's go to for anything  building and maintenance related for our rental properties. We are located out of the area and having a reliable local tradesman gives us confidence our investments are in good hands whenever we need works completed. He is courteous, punctual and professional. Highly recommend!

realReviews.author: Kingsley Waterson
realReviews.text: A great company. I have used Brandon on a variety of projects including carpet and wardrobes removal, bathroom and kitchen repairs. More recently, Brandon undertook the cleaning out and preparing of a home for sale, making the whole process significantly less stressful. Brandon is reliable, reasonable and importantly, will work through with you the project or task at hand. Highly recommended by myself.

finalCta.headline: Ready to get the job list sorted?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits. You'll get a clear quote before anything's booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straight chat about the job.

faq.a: Send your job list through the form, with photos if you've got them, or give Brandon a ring. You'll get a clear quote and an honest timeframe before anything starts.
The Northern Beaches, from Manly up to Palm Beach. Not sure if you're in range? Ask anyway.

faq.q: Can you do several small jobs in one visit?
faq.a: Yes. Send the whole list: carpentry, repairs and odd jobs can be worked through in one visit.

faq.q: I own a rental but live out of the area. Can you help?
faq.a: Yes. Brandon already looks after rental properties for owners who live out of the area.
Ask when you request your quote and we'll send the licence and insurance details for your job.
